{{Quote|These are no higher than the peaks of Kyrimorut. I used to climb them in basic training.|Bo-Katan Kryze|<ref name="The Foundling" />}}
'''Kyrimorut''' was a mountainous location. [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] climbed Kyrimorut's [[mountain]]s during her basic training. She recalled doing so while planning a [[Rescue of Ragnar Vizsla|mission]] to rescue the [[Foundling]] [[Ragnar Vizsla|Ragnar]] from a [[shriek-hawk]], who nested on a similar peak.<ref name="The Foundling" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kyrimorut was first mentioned in "[[Chapter 20: The Foundling]]," the fourth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]].<ref name="The Foundling" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Kyrimorut was a haven for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] deserters that was introduced in [[Karen Traviss]]'s [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''.<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
